text:
Gus sits immediately after Cara, and the Finn–Gus gap of exactly one slot together with the Cara–Finn separation forces Finn three slots after Cara, giving the block Cara, Gus, (open), Finn.

Ann, Hana, and Ivo all precede Cara, with exactly one slot between Ann and Ivo and Ann before Hana. That block cannot start at slot 4: Ivo would then sit in 3 and Gus in 5, only two apart. It cannot start at slot 6 either: Elif must be at least three after Cara, and slot 9 is already Finn. Cara is therefore in 5, Gus in 6, Finn in 8.

Elif must be at least three after Cara, so Elif is in 9. Exactly one slot between Dev and Elif puts Dev in 7. The four early slots are then Ann, Hana, Ivo, and Ben; Ann in 1 with one slot before Ivo puts Ivo in 3, Hana in 2, and Ben in 4 to stay three slots from Ann.
